authority: Owner standing direction 1 (15 Oct 2026): Meshy, no generation cap; reference-backed agent-drafted art.
method: Meshy has no texture-generation endpoint (checked https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api and openapi.json: Retexture only re-textures an existing model). Generated as a seamless square image with POST /openapi/v1/image-to-image (nano-banana-pro, generate_multi_view false, aspect_ratio 1:1) from the three reference boards, then a 32-px gradient-domain wrap-seam correction (local script, no external pixels).

chosen_concept.prompt: Seamless tileable square texture, top-down orthographic view, flat even lighting, no perspective: pale warm cream-beige dune sand with gentle wind ripple marks running diagonally, a few tiny pebbles and shell flecks, Lake Michigan Sleeping Bear dunes palette, stylised hand-painted game texture in the Palworld style, edges wrap seamlessly on all four sides, represents a 4 metre square patch. No red, no text, no footprints.

integration_status: candidate, flag-off; albedo/mask only (no normal/roughness generated)
credits_note: Sum of consumed_credits reported by the Meshy task API for every task listed in tasks_with_credits.
visual_verdict: Good: pale warm cream sand with diagonal ripples, seamless; albedo is very bright (mean RGB about 247/225/193), darken in material.
